propositions: A Dockerized Jira DC harness serving Jira 8.17.1 at http://localhost:2990/jira is built (not pulled) from a vendored Dockerfile pinning the addono base by digest, to serve as a verification oracle for the DC adapter.

The vendored Dockerfile must keep -DskipAllPrompts=true and -Dproduct.start.timeout on the atlas-run entrypoint, or cold starts fail via the retired Marketplace v1 endpoint and Cargo's 600000ms deploy ceiling silently kills the container.

The harness lives under tests/external/ so it inherits the external tier's opt-in guard (REBAR_RUN_EXTERNAL=1) and skips (not fails) when the instance is absent, while the jira_live canary fails the session on a vacuous all-skip.

The base image is linux/amd64 and only usable on a native amd64 runner; on emulated arm64 the instance never becomes ready within the timeout, so acceptance evidence must be produced on native x86_64 CI.
Smoke tests prove REST v2 create/read round-trip and PAT bearer auth minted via POST /rest/pat/latest/tokens against a real Jira 8.x Server deployment (not Cloud).

Teardown is index-independent per ADR 0037 — asserting delete HTTP status and polling each issue's direct /rest/api/2/issue/{key} endpoint for 404, never consulting search — and a session guard refuses to run against residual RBJ-prefixed projects.
